title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
abstract: arXiv:2611.28618v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. translated_title: 从有限的交互经验中蒸馏视觉智能体
translated_abstract: 蒸馏出一个有能力的视觉智能体需要多少交互经验？我们研究了从少量任务和记录的交互历史中学习的问题。我们的框架利用技能-上下文覆盖率与有序视觉决策相似度来选择代表性轨迹。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在选定任务上进行全新交互，或在固定交互历史下生成学生模型的新响应来学习。在导航、推箱子（Sokoban）和空间映射任务上，即便只有一个在线训练任务也能支持向其他任务的迁移。四条固定轨迹将4B学生模型在标准导航任务上的成功率从49.17%提升至82.08%，在推箱子任务上从60.16%提升至85.55%，在这些测试面板上恢复了相对于27B教师模型测得差距的90%以上。在一个独立的导航面板上，轨迹回放将成功率从45.83%提高到76.67%，在优化过程中无需新的交互即可保留同类在线增益的91.36%。训练重复次数、匹配的监督微调（SFT）……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种从极少交互经验中蒸馏视觉智能体的框架，通过技能-上下文覆盖率与视觉决策相似度选取代表性轨迹并结合在线策略蒸馏，仅用一条在线任务或四条固定轨迹即可使4B学生模型恢复27B教师模型90%以上的性能差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework for distilling capable visual agents from minimal interaction experience, using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity to select representative trajectories with on-policy distillation, showing that even one online training task or four fixed trajectories enable a 4B student to recover over 90% of the performance gap to a 27B teacher.
